subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'FEATURE' is coded as 1001010 and 'CANDID' is coded as 101101. How will 'HOLIDAY' be coded in the same language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] The logic followed here is:​ Vowel → Coded as (0) Consonants → Coded as (1) 'FEATURE' is coded as 1001010
